caption: The drawing depicts a single stylized eagle, positioned horizontally across the center of a plain, light beige background. The eagle is illustrated in shades of brown and reddish-brown, with detailed feather texture visible throughout its body, wings, and tail. The wings are outstretched and extend symmetrically from each side of the body, tapering to points with visible feather separation along the edges. The eagle's head is turned slightly to one side, showing a prominent yellowish beak. The eagle's talons and legs are not visible, as they appear to be tucked beneath the body or concealed by the feathers. The background remains empty and does not contain any additional figures or objects.
title: Eagle Stern Piece
